peg.volatility_score_basis: MEASURES NAV BEHAVIOUR PLUS ASSET-SIDE PEG RISK, NOT DEVIATION FROM $1 — this is a NAV-accruing ERC-4626, so the question is discount-to-NAV. CUT 7.0 -> 6.5 in June 2026 when the asset-side risk MATERIALISED rather than remained theoretical. The vault itself still accrues normally (CR 100% by construction, yield ~13% APY inside STRC's 11-15% band) — ⚠️ AND 'CR 100% BY CONSTRUCTION' IS AN IDENTITY, NOT A SOLVENCY READING: a wrapper's shares are defined against its own holdings, so the ratio cannot print otherwise. The risk is entirely on the ASSET side: the underlying apxUSD is undercollateralized (~95%). ⚠️ HEADLINE NAV GROWTH SINCE LAUNCH STILL INCLUDES THE ONE-TIME WEEK-1 JUMP (~33%); A NEW BUYER EARNS ONLY THE ONGOING RATE, so launch-to-date return is not an achievable forward return.

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: MEASURES OBSERVED SECONDARY DEPTH PLUS THE DISCRETION BEHIND IT. CUT 5.5 -> 3.5 at the June 2026 depeg. Live derived depth 3.5 with baseline slippage ~430bps. ⚠️ THE DURABLE FINDING IS NOT THE SLIPPAGE NUMBER BUT WHO CONTROLS IT: Apyx PULLS ITS OWN DEPTH OFF-HOURS, so this is VARIABLE AND DISCRETIONARY liquidity, not a standing book. A weekend or off-hours reading OVERSTATES the stress case and an in-hours reading understates the holder's exposure to the issuer's choice — state the timestamp with any depth quote for this asset or it is not interpretable. ⚠️ Depth-constrained at institutional sizing, where the cooldown becomes the binding constraint rather than slippage.

liquidity.liquidity_score_depth_caveat: ⚠️ THE FEED REPORTS `total_2pct_depth: 100000` WITH `total_2pct_depth_is_floor: true` AND `two_pct_depth_status: 'ladder_exhausted'`. That is NOT a measurement of $100k of depth — it is the ladder reporting that it ran out without resolving a 2% crossing. Reading $100,000 as tested depth inverts the finding: the status says the probe FAILED to bound it, which is a worse signal than a small measured number, not a better one.

dependencies.underlying_score_basis: MEASURES THE COUNTERPARTY CHAIN THIS WRAPPER RESTS ON: apyUSD -> apxUSD -> STRC -> Strategy Inc -> BTC. ⚠️ RAISED 2.5 -> 3.0 ON 2026-09-09 WHEN THE WRAPPER AXIS-4 RULE SETTLED AS 'EQUAL, DON'T NOTCH', AND THE DIVERGENCE CLOSED BY INTERNAL MOVING TO PUBLISHED — the direction the evidence pointed, not the one I had argued. The deciding argument was one I had half-written and then failed to follow: EQUAL satisfies both readings of the spec, NOTCHING satisfies only one, and both of the spec's worked examples are equal (sUSDS = USDS, apyUSD = apxUSD). A rule whose own worked examples contradict it is not a rule. ⚠️ I had proposed a 'nameability' test — notch unless no independently-failing wrapper dependency can be named — and it FAILS ON sUSDS, which the spec sets equal despite sUSDS having its own vault, accrual and admin. I tested it against the case it was invented for and not against the case that breaks it. THE SUBSTANCE BELOW THE NOTCH IS UNCHANGED AND STILL CORRECT; only the notch was withdrawn.
